description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'VersionedGestureDetector' for handling gesture detection across different Android SDK versions. It includes nested classes for specific implementations tailored to different Android API levels, such as 'CupcakeDetector', 'EclairDetector', and 'FroyoDetector'. The class provides mechanisms to instantiate version-appropriate detectors, handle touch events, and notify listeners about drag and scale gestures.

classes.name: VersionedGestureDetector
classes.description: An abstract class providing version-aware gesture detection for touch events, with nested classes implementing detection logic for specific Android API levels.

classes.name: VersionedGestureDetector.OnGestureListener
classes.description: Interface defining callbacks for drag and scale gestures.

classes.name: CupcakeDetector
classes.description: Implementation of gesture detection for very early Android versions (Cupcake, API < ECLAIR), handling basic drag gestures.

classes.name: EclairDetector
classes.description: Gesture detection implementation for Android Eclair (API >= ECLAIR), supporting multiple touch pointers.

classes.name: FroyoDetector
classes.description: Extends EclairDetector with scaling gesture support using ScaleGestureDetector, for Android Froyo (API >= FROYO).

methods.name: VersionedGestureDetector.newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a version-appropriate gesture detector instance based on the device's SDK version.

methods.name: VersionedGestureDetector.onTouchEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for handling touch events.
